description: Create the search, once the person has agreed to its size. The engine builds every candidate strategy itself out of the pool you give it -- the whole signal library unless narrowed by class or by naming signals -- and draws the parameters too. USE size_sweep FIRST and say the run count it reports: this call creates a draft and validates it, and a person who has not heard a total has not agreed to one. Still free; only launch_sweep spends. If valid comes back false, errors says why in Oracle's words, nothing was kept, and the fix is another attempt. Nothing runs until launch_sweep.

candidate_shape.description: How many parts a drawn strategy gets, any of n_entry_triggers, min_entry_filters, max_entry_filters, min_exit_triggers, max_exit_triggers, min_exit_filters, max_exit_filters. Omitted, the platform default shape.

candle_sizes.description: Candle sizes, e.g. ["1h"]. Omitted, every size Oracle holds for those assets, which multiplies the windows.

categories.description: Draw only from these signal classes, e.g. ["momentum"]. The classes are averaging, flow, momentum, oscillator, pattern and volatility. Omitted, the whole library.

draws_per_dataset.description: How many candidate strategies to draw PER WINDOW. The runs that execute are this multiplied by the number of windows.

entry_filters.description: Draw entry filters only from these. Omitted, every filter.

entry_triggers.description: Draw the entry trigger only from these signals, named as the knowledge graph registers them. Omitted, every trigger.

execution_base.description: Risk settings every run shares, from the execution config schema. Omitted, platform canon.

execution_sweeps.description: Execution parameters to search too, each {param: {min, max, n}}. Every one of these multiplies the run count.

exit_filters.description: Draw exit filters only from these.

exit_triggers.description: Draw an exit trigger only from these. Omitted, no exit signal is drawn at all and runs exit on the risk settings.

include_gapped.description: Include windows missing bars. Off by default, because a metric over a half-covered window is not comparable to one over a whole window.

max_total_runs.description: A ceiling on the executed runs, applied by Oracle.

param_samples.description: How many values each signal parameter contributes. The space is their product, so this is the dial that decides whether the search explores parameters at all; at 1 every candidate runs at a single setting.

pre_filter_threshold.description: Skip a drawn candidate the SIEVE model predicts will not trade at all, above this confidence. A will-it-trade gate and nothing about whether it will make money. Omitted, no skipping.

regimes.description: Market conditions to keep: current, bear, neutral, bull. current means data within the last 30 days, which is recency and not direction. Omitted, every condition.

signal_groups.description: Keep kinds of signal apart. A candidate draws ALL of its signals from ONE group, so two signals in different groups never appear on the same strategy. Runs are split across the groups.

categories.description: Signal classes whose members belong to it.

filters.description: Select which group members may serve as filters. Role selections only narrow the parent membership; they cannot reassign a signal's role.

include.description: Signal names forced in even when their class is not listed.

triggers.description: Select which group members may serve as triggers.

weight.description: Its share of the strategies drawn. Omitted on every group is an even split.

windows.description: Specific window files to include whatever else is chosen.

name: create_sweep
